release_note.en: conversion and app bundles verified on the Python host; listening, app and publication pending

note.en: No native demo yet. Results of the Python host are not app support.

conversion-20261117.toolchain: Xcode 27.2 (27B52); Python 3.11.9; torch 2.9.0; transformers 4.57.3; coreai-core 1.0.0b3; coreai-torch 0.4.3
conversion-20261117.backend: Python Core AI host, GPU-preferred specialization; compute units not profiled
conversion-20261117.route: VoxCPM2 recipe: original FP32 CPU reference -> component comparisons -> FP32 generation from text -> debug-information removal -> FP32 bundle re-check

workload.en: Five fixed sentences with seed 1708: 3,934 component comparisons that decide the result, FP32 generation from text with at most one replaced patch per sentence (3 of 239), and the same comparisons with the FP32 bundle after debug-information removal. No app; the Python host only.
workload.ja: 固定の5文・seed 1708。合否に使う部品の照合3,934件、文章からのFP32の生成(置き換えは各文1パッチ以下、239中3)、デバッグ情報を除いたFP32のbundleでの同じ照合。アプリではなくPythonのホストだけ。

precision-20261117.toolchain: Xcode 27.2 (27B52); Python 3.11.9; torch 2.9.0; transformers 4.57.3; coreai-core 1.0.0b3; coreai-torch 0.4.3
precision-20261117.backend: Python Core AI host, GPU-preferred specialization; compute units not profiled
precision-20261117.route: VoxCPM2 recipe synthesis_compare: exported assets, one worker process per generation

workload.en: Five sentences x seeds 1708-1710 per configuration, each timed after one warm-up generation in the same worker; load average 4.1-6.1. Recorded without a pass or fail. The bundles hold the same programs without debug information.
workload.ja: 構成ごとに5文×seed 1708〜1710。各生成は同じworkerでのwarm-up 1回の後に計時。load average 4.1〜6.1。合否なしの記録。bundleはデバッグ情報を除いた同じprogram。

memory-20261117.toolchain: Xcode 27.2 (27B52); Python 3.11.9; torch 2.9.0; transformers 4.57.3; coreai-core 1.0.0b3; coreai-torch 0.4.3
memory-20261117.backend: Python Core AI host, GPU-preferred specialization; compute units not profiled
memory-20261117.route: One new Python process per bundle: load -> one generation of long -> release, under the shared heavy-job lock
memory-20261117.artifact_revision: bundles of 20261116T204724-264d1994 (same main.mlirb and main.hash as the current fp32 and fp16 bundles)

workload.en: Sentence long (97 text tokens, 105 patches, 16.8 s of audio), seed 1708, first generation of the process. Process memory sampled before and after load, after the generation and after release by a one-off script outside the repository. Recorded without a pass or fail; not app memory.
workload.ja: 文long(97 token、105パッチ、音声16.8秒)、seed 1708、プロセスで最初の生成。ロードの前後、生成の後、解放の後にプロセスのメモリを、リポジトリの外の1回限りのスクリプトで採取。合否なしの記録で、アプリのメモリではない。

note.en: fp32 bundle: 22 files, including the manifest, tokenizer, license and notice.
note.ja: fp32のbundle。manifest・tokenizer・license・noticeを含む22ファイル。

note.en: fp16 bundle: 22 files. FP16 results are recorded only.
note.ja: fp16のbundle。22ファイル。FP16の結果は記録だけ。

note.en: fp16_proj32 bundle (FP16 with proj in FP32): 22 files. FP16 results are recorded only.
note.ja: fp16_proj32のbundle(projだけFP32)。22ファイル。FP16の結果は記録だけ。

note.en: Largest FP32 component error (max abs error / max abs reference), dit.main; proj.fuse is judged by classes instead (233 match, 1 boundary-consistent, 0 fail). n counts dit.main calls.
note.ja: FP32の部品の最大誤差(最大絶対誤差/参照の最大絶対値)、dit.main。proj.fuseは分類で判定(一致233・境界整合1・不合格0)。nはdit.mainの呼び出し数。

note.en: fp32: generation seconds per second of audio, after one warm-up; excludes loading and saving.
note.ja: fp32。音声1秒あたりの生成秒数。warm-up 1回の後。ロードと保存を除く。

note.en: fp16: as above. Audio follows a different trajectory from FP32; listening pending.
note.ja: fp16。同上。FP32と別の軌道の音声。試聴は未完了。

note.en: fp16_proj32: as above. Audio follows a different trajectory from FP32; listening pending.
note.ja: fp16_proj32。同上。FP32と別の軌道の音声。試聴は未完了。

note.en: fp32: one generation of long (16.8 s of audio) as the first of a new process; excludes the 7.07 s load.
note.ja: fp32。新しいプロセスで最初のlongの生成(音声16.8秒)。7.07秒のロードを除く。

note.en: fp16: one generation of long (16.8 s of audio) as the first of a new process; excludes the 3.40 s load.
note.ja: fp16。新しいプロセスで最初のlongの生成(音声16.8秒)。3.40秒のロードを除く。
